topics: Analog and Digital Data and Signals; Periodic Signals
keyPoints: Data can be analog (continuous) or digital (discrete); so can signals.
We commonly use periodic analog signals and nonperiodic digital signals (slide 9).
Sine wave properties: peak amplitude, frequency, phase.
Phase describes the position of the waveform relative to time 0.
Wavelength = propagation speed × period = propagation speed / frequency.
